The [[Syboona]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Knire Dark]] owned a '''storehouse''' that she used for storing her illegal merchandise. It was raided by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|authorities]]<ref name="HNN" /> around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Sepan">[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 49|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #49]] provides a [[Great ReSynchronization]] date of 13:3:28. This date corresponds to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] on the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]], according to [[Template:YearMathGRS|the following explanation]].</ref> ending Dark's career.<ref name="SWE">{{CSWECite|I|166|Dark, Knire}}</ref> The raid was chronicled in ''[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 49]]'', an issue of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]], that was released during the same year of the incident. Due to Dark's attachment to [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]], the article noted that the event, along with several other Podracing related incidents, called for the sport of Podracing to be heavily scrutinized.<ref name="HNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
The storehouse was first mentioned in an issue of the HoloNet News.<ref name="HNN" /> It was mentioned again under Knire Dark's entry in [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="SWE" />
